check_code:
import itertools
# universe of types over (spoon,fork,knife,spatula); check conclusions over all models
types=[t for t in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4) if (not t[0] or t[1]) and (not t[1] or t[2]) and not(t[2] and t[3])]
res=[True,True,True]
import itertools as it
for r in range(1,len(types)+1):
    for m in it.combinations(types,r):
        if not any(t[0] for t in m): continue  # spoons exist
        c1=any(t[2] and t[0] for t in m)
        c2=not any(t[1] and t[3] for t in m)
        c3=any(t[0] and t[3] for t in m)
        res[0]&=c1;res[1]&=c2;res[2]&=c3
assert res==[True,True,False]
